name: poly-capture
description: Layer 1 of polyphony: read the full held-note list of a track and copy every held note+velocity into a destination buffer. Contract: capture(track_ptr, dest_ptr) -> count. track+0x120 = element count (<=24), elements are 12 bytes at track+12*i, note at element+8, velocity at element+9. dest receives count*2 bytes as [note, vel] pairs. This routine is position-independent (no absolute references) so it can be tested at any load address and later wired into the commit path.
